verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is that Devin's scheduling tools support "notification preferences" (devin-docs-17). Slack/Teams sessions started from a conversation thread (devin-docs-4, devin-docs-19) suggest a channel where results could come back, but the docs never say Devin notifies you on completion or when it needs input. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of task-completion notifications, alerts when Devin is blocked or needs input, details of notification channels (Slack, email, push, webhooks), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
